title: Matthew Chapter 26 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Matthew chapter 26 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Matthew Chapter 26 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Matthew Chapter 26.

questions.question: In Matthew 26, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Jesus tells his disciples the Son of man will be betrayed and crucified
Judas offers to betray Jesus for thirty pieces of silver
A woman pours precious ointment on Jesus' head
The chief priests assemble at Caiaphas' palace
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus tells his disciples the Son of man will be betrayed and crucified
questions.explanation: Jesus first speaks to his disciples about his betrayal and crucifixion in Matthew 26:1-2, which occurs before the other listed events.

questions.question: Who assembled together at the palace of the high priest according to Matthew 26?
options: The chief priests, scribes, and elders
questions.correctAnswer: The chief priests, scribes, and elders
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:3 states that the chief priests, scribes, and elders assembled together at the palace of the high priest.

questions.question: What was the reason given by the chief priests for not arresting Jesus on the feast day?
options: Lest there be an uproar among the people
They did not have enough soldiers
They wanted to wait for a better opportunity
questions.correctAnswer: Lest there be an uproar among the people
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:5 explains that the chief priests did not want to arrest Jesus on the feast day to avoid an uproar among the people.

questions.question: Where was Jesus when the woman poured ointment on him?
options: In Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper
questions.correctAnswer: In Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:6 states that Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper when the woman poured ointment on him.

questions.question: What did the disciples say about the ointment poured on Jesus?
options: To what purpose is this waste?
questions.correctAnswer: To what purpose is this waste?
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:8 records the disciples expressing indignation by saying, 'To what purpose is this waste?'

questions.question: What did Jesus say was the reason the woman poured ointment on his body?
questions.correctAnswer: For my burial
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:12 states that Jesus said she poured the ointment on his body for his burial.

questions.question: How much did Judas agree to receive to betray Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: Thirty pieces of silver
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:15 says Judas covenanted with the chief priests for thirty pieces of silver to betray Jesus.

questions.question: On which day did the disciples ask Jesus where to prepare the Passover?
options: The first day of the feast of unleavened bread
The last day of the feast
questions.correctAnswer: The first day of the feast of unleavened bread
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:17 states the disciples came to Jesus on the first day of the feast of unleavened bread to ask about preparing the Passover.

questions.question: What did Jesus instruct the disciples to say to the man whose house they were to use for the Passover?
options: The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
Prepare the room for a feast.
Tell the people to gather at the temple.
Wait for us at the Mount of Olives.
questions.correctAnswer: The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:18 records Jesus telling the disciples to say this to the man whose house they were to use.

questions.question: What did Jesus say would happen during the meal with the twelve disciples?
options: One of you shall betray me.
questions.correctAnswer: One of you shall betray me.
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:21 states that Jesus said one of the twelve would betray him during the meal.

questions.question: Who asked Jesus, 'Lord, is it I?' when he said one would betray him?
options: All the disciples, each one individually
questions.correctAnswer: All the disciples, each one individually
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:22 says they were exceeding sorrowful and each began to say to Jesus, 'Lord, is it I?'

questions.question: True or False: Jesus said that the poor will always be with the disciples but He will not always be with them.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:11 records Jesus saying, 'For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.'

questions.question: True or False: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve disciples who betrayed Jesus.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:14 identifies Judas Iscariot as one of the twelve who went to the chief priests to betray Jesus.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus told Judas that it was not him who would betray Him.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:25 shows Jesus telling Judas 'Thou hast said,' confirming Judas was the betrayer.

questions.question: True or False: The disciples prepared the Passover meal in a house Jesus appointed them to.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:19 states the disciples did as Jesus appointed and made ready the Passover meal in the house.

medium.title: Matthew Chapter 26 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Matthew Chapter 26 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did Jesus say the bread represents?
options: This is a symbol of faith
questions.correctAnswer: This is my body
questions.explanation: Jesus took bread and said, 'Take, eat; this is my body.' (Matthew 26:26)

questions.question: What does Matthew 26:27 promise will happen if someone drinks from the cup?
questions.correctAnswer: They will be forgiven
questions.explanation: Jesus states that the cup represents His blood, which is shed for the remission of sins. (Matthew 26:28)

questions.question: What did Jesus say about drinking the fruit of the vine?
options: He will drink it anew with them
He will never drink it again
questions.correctAnswer: He will drink it anew with them
questions.explanation: Jesus said He would not drink of the fruit of the vine until He drinks it new in His Father's kingdom. (Matthew 26:29)

questions.question: What does Matthew 26:30 tell us the disciples did after the meal?
questions.correctAnswer: They sang a hymn
questions.explanation: After they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives. (Matthew 26:30)

questions.question: What did Jesus predict would happen to the disciples that night?
options: They would be filled with the Holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: They would all be offended
questions.explanation: Jesus said, 'All ye shall be offended because of me this night.' (Matthew 26:31)

questions.question: What did Peter insist he would do, despite Jesus' warning?
questions.correctAnswer: He would not be offended
questions.explanation: Peter said, 'Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.' (Matthew 26:33)

questions.question: Why did Jesus go to Gethsemane with His disciples?
questions.correctAnswer: To pray
questions.explanation: Jesus asked the disciples to sit while He went to pray. (Matthew 26:36)

questions.question: What did Jesus ask Peter and the disciples to do in Gethsemane?
questions.correctAnswer: Watch and pray
questions.explanation: Jesus told them to watch and pray that they enter not into temptation. (Matthew 26:41)

questions.question: What did Jesus say about the spirit and the flesh?
options: The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak
questions.correctAnswer: The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak
questions.explanation: Jesus stated, 'The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.' (Matthew 26:41)

questions.question: What did Jesus say when He found the disciples asleep?
questions.correctAnswer: Sleep on now
questions.explanation: Jesus said, 'Sleep on now, and take your rest.' (Matthew 26:45)

questions.question: What was Judas' signal for betraying Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: A kiss
questions.explanation: Judas said that he would kiss the one he betrayed, and that would be the sign. (Matthew 26:48)

questions.question: What did Jesus call Judas when he approached to betray Him?
questions.correctAnswer: Friend
questions.explanation: Jesus addressed Judas as 'Friend' when he approached to betray Him. (Matthew 26:50)

questions.question: Is it true that Jesus prayed three times in Gethsemane?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Jesus went away to pray three times, each time returning to find the disciples asleep. (Matthew 26:39, 42, 44)

questions.question: Is it true that Jesus instructed His disciples to drink from the cup only once?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed His disciples to drink from the cup, saying 'Drink ye all of it.' (Matthew 26:27)

questions.question: Is it true that Peter denied knowing Jesus only once?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Jesus foretold that Peter would deny Him three times before the cock crows. (Matthew 26:34)

hard.title: Matthew Chapter 26 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Matthew Chapter 26.

questions.question: According to Matthew 26:51, what did one of those with Jesus do when Jesus was arrested?
options: Drew his sword and struck a servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear
Ran away and hid among the crowd
Confronted the chief priests with words
questions.correctAnswer: Drew his sword and struck a servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:51 states that one of those with Jesus stretched out his hand, drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

questions.question: What reason does Jesus give in Matthew 26:52 for instructing to put away the sword?
options: For all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword
Because it was not the time for violence
Because the authorities had the legal right to arrest Him
Because it would cause a riot
questions.correctAnswer: For all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword
questions.explanation: In Matthew 26:52, Jesus instructs to put away the sword because 'all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.'

questions.question: In Matthew 26:53, Jesus mentions that He could pray to His Father to send how many legions of angels for His defense?
questions.correctAnswer: More than twelve legions
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:53 records Jesus saying He could pray to His Father and He would send more than twelve legions of angels.

questions.question: What reason does Jesus give in Matthew 26:54 for not calling on angels to prevent His arrest?
options: So that the scriptures might be fulfilled
Because the angels were not near
Because He had no power at that moment
questions.correctAnswer: So that the scriptures might be fulfilled
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:54 states that Jesus refrains from calling angels so that the scriptures might be fulfilled.

questions.question: In Matthew 26:56, what happens to the disciples after Jesus is arrested?
options: All the disciples forsook him and fled
They prayed together for His deliverance
questions.correctAnswer: All the disciples forsook him and fled
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:56 explains that all the disciples forsook Jesus and fled after His arrest.

questions.question: According to Matthew 26:69, where was Peter when a damsel accused him of being with Jesus?
questions.correctAnswer: Sitting outside in the palace
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:69 states that Peter was sitting outside in the palace when a damsel accused him of being with Jesus.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'legion' (Matthew 26:53) mean?
questions.correctAnswer: A unit of about 6,000 soldiers
questions.explanation: The Greek word 'legion' (λεγιών) refers to a Roman military unit of about 6,000 soldiers, as used in Matthew 26:53.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Matthew 26:54 when Jesus says 'But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?'
questions.correctAnswer: Foreshadowing
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:54 uses foreshadowing as Jesus indicates the forthcoming events are necessary to fulfill scripture.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage is echoed by Jesus' statement in Matthew 26:31 about the shepherd being struck and the sheep scattering?
questions.correctAnswer: Zechariah 13:7
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:31 quotes Zechariah 13:7, which prophesies the striking of the shepherd and the scattering of the sheep.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage fulfills the theme of Peter's denial as described in Matthew 26:69-75?
questions.explanation: John 18:15-27 also describes Peter's denial of Jesus, paralleling Matthew 26:69-75.

questions.question: What event immediately precedes the arrest of Jesus in Matthew 26?
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus' prayer in Gethsemane
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:36-46 records Jesus praying in Gethsemane immediately before His arrest in verse 47.

questions.question: What is the significance of Jesus' silence when accused before the high priest in Matthew 26:63?
options: It fulfills the prophecy of the suffering servant in Isaiah 53
It shows His lack of defense
It indicates uncertainty about His identity
It is a sign of submission to the elders
questions.correctAnswer: It fulfills the prophecy of the suffering servant in Isaiah 53
questions.explanation: Jesus' silence in Matthew 26:63 fulfills Isaiah 53:7, where the suffering servant does not open his mouth.

questions.question: What type of literary structure is evident in Matthew 26:69-75 regarding Peter’s denial?
questions.correctAnswer: Chiasm
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:69-75 portrays a chiasm, where Peter's three denials are structured symmetrically around the crowing of the cock.

questions.question: What is the cultural significance of the cock crowing in the context of Peter's denial in Matthew 26:74?
options: It signaled the start of a new day, fulfilling Jesus' prediction
It was a sign for the guards to arrest Peter
It indicated that the temple was opening
It was a call to prayer for the disciples
questions.correctAnswer: It signaled the start of a new day, fulfilling Jesus' prediction
questions.explanation: In Matthew 26:74, the crowing of the cock signaled dawn and fulfilled Jesus' prediction that Peter would deny Him before the cock crowed.

questions.question: Peter's remorse after denying Jesus is shown in which verse and how is it expressed?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:75 shows Peter weeping bitterly after remembering Jesus' prophecy about his denial, demonstrating deep remorse.

theological.title: Matthew Chapter 26 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Matthew Chapter 26 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Matthew 26:12 teach about salvation?
options: Christ's anointing signifies preparation for His burial and atonement
Salvation is based on human works and generosity to the poor
The pouring of ointment is a symbol of future resurrection only
Salvation is achieved through adherence to feast day rituals
questions.correctAnswer: Christ's anointing signifies preparation for His burial and atonement
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:12 states that the woman poured ointment on Jesus' body for His burial, indicating His anointing prefigures His sacrificial death for salvation.

questions.question: What doctrine about human sin does Matthew 26:24 teach?
options: The betrayal of Christ fulfills Scripture and results in severe judgment
Human sin can be overcome by personal effort without divine intervention
Betrayal is a minor failing easily forgiven without consequence
The Son of man will forgive all sins except betrayal
questions.correctAnswer: The betrayal of Christ fulfills Scripture and results in severe judgment
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:24 teaches that the betrayal is a fulfillment of Scripture and that the betrayer faces woe, indicating the serious consequences of sin.

questions.question: What doctrine about Jesus’ messianic authority does Matthew 26:64 teach?
options: Jesus declares His future exaltation and divine judgment as Son of man
Jesus denies being the Christ and refuses to answer the high priest
Jesus claims only to be a prophet with no divine authority
Jesus states He will establish a political kingdom immediately
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus declares His future exaltation and divine judgment as Son of man
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:64 records Jesus affirming that He is the Christ who will sit at the right hand of power and come in the clouds, revealing His divine authority and eschatological role.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Matthew 26:39 specifically demonstrate?
options: Submission to the will of the Father
questions.correctAnswer: Submission to the will of the Father
questions.explanation: In Matthew 26:39, Jesus prays ‘not as I will, but as thou wilt,’ showing His submission to the Father's sovereign will.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Matthew 26:53 specifically demonstrate?
options: Omnipotence in commanding legions of angels
questions.correctAnswer: Omnipotence in commanding legions of angels
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:53 shows Jesus' awareness of His divine omnipotence, claiming He could call upon more than twelve legions of angels for defense.

questions.question: How does Matthew 26:2 prepare for the theme of substitutionary atonement elsewhere in Scripture?
options: By announcing the Son of man will be betrayed and crucified, pointing to His sacrificial death
By emphasizing the feast of Passover as a purely cultural event
By focusing on the disciples’ future leadership roles
By predicting the destruction of the temple
questions.correctAnswer: By announcing the Son of man will be betrayed and crucified, pointing to His sacrificial death
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:2 anticipates Jesus' betrayal and crucifixion, which aligns with the Old Testament sacrificial system and points to His substitutionary death for sin.

questions.question: How does Matthew 26:31 connect to the broader redemptive-historical theme of shepherd and sheep in Scripture?
options: It references the scattering of the sheep, fulfilling Zechariah’s prophecy of the smitten shepherd
It anticipates the destruction of Israel’s political kingdom exclusively
It symbolizes the ultimate triumph of the disciples over persecution
It predicts the permanent failure of Jesus’ mission
questions.correctAnswer: It references the scattering of the sheep, fulfilling Zechariah’s prophecy of the smitten shepherd
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:31 quotes Zechariah 13:7 about the shepherd being struck and the sheep scattered, linking Jesus’ arrest to prophetic fulfillment.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Matthew 26:26 and 26:28 teach about the Lord's Supper?
options: The bread and cup symbolize Christ's body and blood, establishing the new covenant for remission of sins
The bread and cup are merely memorials without covenant significance
The Lord's Supper is a purely social meal with no theological meaning
The cup represents judgment against the disciples only
questions.correctAnswer: The bread and cup symbolize Christ's body and blood, establishing the new covenant for remission of sins
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:26 and 26:28 reveal Jesus instituting the Lord’s Supper as a sign of His body and blood, inaugurating the new covenant for forgiveness.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Matthew 26:40 and 26:41 teach about human weakness and spiritual vigilance?
options: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak, so believers must watch and pray to avoid temptation
Human nature is wholly depraved and cannot resist sin even with prayer
Prayer is unnecessary because God's spirit will prevent all sin
Fleshly weakness is an excuse for sin with no need for vigilance
questions.correctAnswer: The spirit is willing but the flesh is weak, so believers must watch and pray to avoid temptation
questions.explanation: In Matthew 26:40-41, Jesus teaches that although believers desire to do right, their fleshly weakness requires prayerful vigilance to resist temptation.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Matthew 26:63 and 26:64 teach about Christ's identity and eschatological role?
options: Jesus affirms He is the Christ and Son of God, who will sit at God's right hand and come in glory
Jesus denies divine sonship and claims only to be a prophet
Jesus refuses to answer, leaving His identity ambiguous
Jesus claims to be a political messiah who will overthrow Rome immediately
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus affirms He is the Christ and Son of God, who will sit at God's right hand and come in glory
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:63-64 records Jesus' confession before the high priest, affirming His messianic and divine identity with eschatological authority.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Matthew 26:47 and 26:50 teach about the fulfillment of Jesus' betrayal and arrest according to divine sovereignty and human responsibility?
options: Jesus' betrayal and arrest fulfill Scripture while involving human agents acting in their own choice
Jesus is forcibly taken against divine will and without prophetic foresight
The arrest is a surprise to Jesus and contradicts earlier predictions
Human agents act without any divine sovereignty or prophetic purpose
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus' betrayal and arrest fulfill Scripture while involving human agents acting in their own choice
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:47 and 26:50 show Judas betraying Jesus and Jesus’ calm acceptance, indicating divine fulfillment alongside human culpability.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Matthew 26:59-61 shows Jesus was falsely accused without any basis. What does the passage actually teach?
options: The religious leaders sought false witness but ultimately used Jesus’ own words about destroying the temple as a charge
Jesus was accused solely on true eyewitness testimony without dispute
The accusations were fabricated entirely without any reference to Jesus’ teachings
The passage shows Jesus confessed to destroying the temple
questions.correctAnswer: The religious leaders sought false witness but ultimately used Jesus’ own words about destroying the temple as a charge
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:59-61 records attempts at false testimony failing, but two witnesses quoted Jesus’ statement about the temple as grounds for accusation.

questions.question: What doctrine does Matthew 26:13 teach about the global proclamation of the gospel?
options: The woman's act of anointing will be remembered wherever the gospel is preached
The gospel is only for the Jewish people and local communities
Memorials are unnecessary once the gospel is preached
The gospel’s spread depends on political power and not acts of devotion
questions.correctAnswer: The woman's act of anointing will be remembered wherever the gospel is preached
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:13 states that the woman's deed will be told as a memorial wherever the gospel is preached, highlighting the universal scope of gospel proclamation.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Matthew 26:55 specifically demonstrate?
options: Impotence in the face of evil
questions.correctAnswer: Justice in confronting wrongful arrest
questions.explanation: In Matthew 26:55 Jesus questions the crowd’s treatment of Him, showing God's justice by highlighting the injustice of His arrest.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Matthew 26:69 and 26:74 teach about human frailty and divine foreknowledge?
options: Peter's denial fulfills Jesus’ prophecy, exemplifying human weakness despite divine foreknowledge
Peter's denial is a failure unforeseen by Jesus
Peter denies Jesus but is immediately forgiven without consequence
Jesus predicts denial but Peter never falters
questions.correctAnswer: Peter's denial fulfills Jesus’ prophecy, exemplifying human weakness despite divine foreknowledge
questions.explanation: Matthew 26:69-74 records Peter’s thrice denial, fulfilling Jesus’ prediction and demonstrating both human frailty and Jesus’ foreknowledge.
